doc: Seven rows: the middle row has latitude exactly 0 (grid_lonlat gives 0.0) and is in NEITHER hemisphere (`lat > 0` and `lat < 0`), so its land fraction 1.0 does not count. Fractional land (float32 row means, exact here: 0.5 and 0.25 are binary fractions). 1e-9. Output `asymmetry` is 0-d: shape [] in case.json, one item of data.bin.
